findings.title: open.sh relies on `status --watch --pane` splitting the right pane from a plugin action
findings.detail:
The old open.sh targeted ctx focused_pane_id or HERDR_WORKSPACE_ID. Now `herdr pane split` runs without --current or a target (splitAndRun), from an action context that may not set HERDR_PANE_ID. Where the split lands, and whether HERDR_ENV reaches the action env (else refusal not_in_herdr → toast), is only observable in real Herdr.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: QA checks norn.open in Herdr with the plugin linked from this branch; if the split lands wrong, pass the focused pane through to openBelow.

findings.title: NAMED_THING skip also hides `the norn <removed>`
findings.detail:
A line such as 'run the norn unstick command' is stripped before matching, so the lint lets it through. This is a narrow loophole and an accepted trade-off for prose like 'a norn workflow'.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optionally skip only when the word after norn is not in REMOVED_COMMANDS.
